subject: English Language
source_note: TIE (2023), English Language Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of English language skills

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and in written language tasks
competences: (a) Prepare and deliver short speeches about common topics (e.g., entrepreneurship, corruption, child rights and security, gender education, cyber security education, disaster management, health and reproductive education, drug abuse, life skills, financial management education, taxation)
(b) Compose different types of essays (narrative, descriptive, argumentative and expository) using correct grammar and vocabulary

objectives.text: (a) Prepare and deliver short speeches about common topics (e.g., entrepreneurship, corruption, child rights and security, gender education, cyber security education, disaster management, health and reproductive education, drug abuse, life skills, financial management education, taxation)
objectives.teaching_methods: Project work, Presentation, Observation, Speech delivery
objectives.resources: Written texts of different types, dictionaries, encyclopaedia, oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Short speeches about common topics are prepared and delivered appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Compose different types of essays (narrative, descriptive, argumentative and expository) using correct grammar and vocabulary
objectives.assessment_criteria: Different types of essays are composed using correct grammar and vocabulary

sub_topics.title: Read texts for comprehension
competences: (a) Discuss the author’s motives in a given text
(b) Deliver an oral presentation about the content of a text
(c) Draw inferences (conclusions) from a text

objectives.text: (a) Discuss the author’s motives in a given text
objectives.assessment_criteria: The author’s motives in the given text are discussed correctly

objectives.text: (b) Deliver an oral presentation about the content of a text
objectives.assessment_criteria: An oral presentation about the content of the text is made appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Draw inferences (conclusions) from a text
objectives.assessment_criteria: Inferences (conclusions) are drawn correctly from the text

sub_topics.title: Comprehend oral messages with increasing difficulty
competences: (a) Deduce the main ideas from an oral presentation or language task
(b) Examine information from oral sources
(c) Relate the core messages of an oral presentation to real life experiences

objectives.text: (a) Deduce the main ideas from an oral presentation or language task
objectives.resources: Oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The main ideas from oral presentations and language tasks are deduced appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Examine information from oral sources
objectives.teaching_methods: Pair work, Group work, Project activity
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information from oral sources is examined appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Relate the core messages of an oral presentation to real life experiences
objectives.teaching_methods: Group work, Pair work, Project activity
objectives.assessment_criteria: The core messages of the oral presentation are related correctly to real-life experiences

sub_topics.title: Construct meaning from a variety of texts
competences: (a) Explore strategies for deriving meanings of words from given texts (e.g., contextual guessing)
(b) Synthesise ideas and draw conclusions from multiple and diverse texts
(c) Write a single text from information and opinions derived from a variety of texts
(d) Make inferences about a variety of texts
(e) Relate the core messages from multiple and diverse texts to real life experiences

objectives.text: (a) Explore strategies for deriving meanings of words from given texts (e.g., contextual guessing)
objectives.resources: Books, dictionaries, encyclopaedia, newspaper articles, journals
objectives.assessment_criteria: Strategies for deriving meanings of words from given texts are explored appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Synthesise ideas and draw conclusions from multiple and diverse texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ideas from multiple and diverse texts are synthesised correctly, and conclusions are drawn correctly

objectives.text: (c) Write a single text from information and opinions derived from a variety of texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: A single text from information and opinions derived from a variety of texts is written correctly

objectives.text: (d) Make inferences about a variety of texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Inferences about a variety of texts are made appropriately

objectives.text: (e) Relate the core messages from multiple and diverse texts to real life experiences
objectives.assessment_criteria: The core messages from multiple and diverse texts are related appropriately to real-life experiences

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication in a variety of contexts
competences: (a) Express feelings and emotions depicted/ portrayed in various social contexts using appropriate phrases (e.g., I am saddened…, I am upset…, my condolences… I feel happy… hurray…)
(b) Deliver different kinds of planned and unplanned speeches (e.g., informative, persuasive speech) on different topics
(c) Negotiate solutions to various problems using appropriate formalaic language (e.g., Would you mind…, don’t you think…, is it possible…, if I were you…)

objectives.text: (a) Express feelings and emotions depicted/ portrayed in various social contexts using appropriate phrases (e.g., I am saddened…, I am upset…, my condolences… I feel happy… hurray…)
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, encyclopaedias, relevant texts (e.g., books for English grammar)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Feelings and emotions depicted/ portrayed in various social contexts are expressed using appropriate phrases

objectives.text: (b) Deliver different kinds of planned and unplanned speeches (e.g., informative, persuasive speech) on different topics
objectives.assessment_criteria: Different kinds of planned and unplanned speeches on different topics are delivered properly

objectives.text: (c) Negotiate solutions to various problems using appropriate formalaic language (e.g., Would you mind…, don’t you think…, is it possible…, if I were you…)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Solutions to various problems are negotiated using appropriate formulaic language

sub_topics.title: Create a variety of texts for different communicative purposes using the appropriate tone and register
competences: (a) Write application letters for various purposes (e.g., job application, school admission)
(b) Write speeches on a variety of topics, including cross-cutting issues
(c) Write Curriculum Vitae (CV) for different purposes

objectives.text: (a) Write application letters for various purposes (e.g., job application, school admission)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Application letters for various purposes are written properly

objectives.text: (b) Write speeches on a variety of topics, including cross-cutting issues
objectives.assessment_criteria: Speeches on a variety of topics, including cross-cutting issues, are written properly

objectives.text: (c) Write Curriculum Vitae (CV) for different purposes
objectives.assessment_criteria: Curriculum Vitae (CV) for different purposes are written properly

sub_topics.title: Conduct a socio-cultural analysis of functional texts
competences: (a) Analyse different functional texts in terms of purpose, content, organisation, format and design
(b) Read a variety of functional texts (e.g., recipes, product manuals, transport schedules, forms, brochures, and menus)
(c) Comment on the usefulness of different functional texts
(d) Compose functional texts to serve various purposes

objectives.text: (a) Analyse different functional texts in terms of purpose, content, organisation, format and design
objectives.resources: Various kinds of functional texts (e.g., recipes, product manuals, transport schedules, forms, brochures, menus)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Different functional texts are analysed correctly in terms of purpose, content, organisation, format and design

objectives.text: (b) Read a variety of functional texts (e.g., recipes, product manuals, transport schedules, forms, brochures, and menus)
objectives.assessment_criteria: A variety of functional texts are read effectively

objectives.text: (c) Comment on the usefulness of different functional texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: The usefulness of different functional texts is commented on appropriately

objectives.text: (d) Compose functional texts to serve various purposes
objectives.assessment_criteria: Functional texts are composed properly to serve various purposes

topics.title: Provide basic English language services to the community

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of editing and proofreading in a variety of texts
competences: (a) Edit and proofread texts in a school context (e.g., school rules and regulations, essays/ compositions)
(b) Edit and proofread short texts in contexts outside the school (e.g. posters, flyers, user manuals)

objectives.text: (a) Edit and proofread texts in a school context (e.g., school rules and regulations, essays/ compositions)
objectives.resources: Relevant texts, school rules and regulations, fliers, user manuals, various essays/ compositions, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: Texts found in the school context are edited and proofread appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Edit and proofread short texts in contexts outside the school (e.g. posters, flyers, user manuals)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Texts found outside the school context are edited and proofread appropriately

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of interpretation to provide simple authentic interpretations
competences: (a) Interpret messages in informal contexts (e.g., family conversations and peer conversations) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(b) Interpret messages in small formal settings (e.g., classroom and subject group discussions) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(c) Interpret messages in large formal settings (e.g., church, mosque and meetings) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa).

objectives.text: (a) Interpret messages in informal contexts (e.g., family conversations and peer conversations) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Messages in informal contexts are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (b) Interpret messages in small formal settings (e.g., classroom and subject group discussions) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Messages in small formal settings are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (c) Interpret messages in large formal settings (e.g., church, mosque and meetings) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa).
objectives.assessment_criteria: Messages in large formal settings are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of translation to produce simple authentic translation
competences: (a) Translate texts in contexts outside the school (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(b) Translate a variety of short texts (e.g., advertisements and functional texts) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(c) Translate a variety of long texts (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (a) Translate texts in contexts outside the school (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Texts found outside the school context are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (b) Translate a variety of short texts (e.g., advertisements and functional texts) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.assessment_criteria: A variety of short texts are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (c) Translate a variety of long texts (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.assessment_criteria: A variety of long texts are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

sub_topics.title: Manage short translation and editing projects using Computer-Assisted Tools
competences: (a) Desribe the use of Computer-Assisted Tools in translating and editing
(b) Use Computer-Assisted Translation Tools to translate and edit short simple texts

objectives.text: (a) Desribe the use of Computer-Assisted Tools in translating and editing
objectives.assessment_criteria: The use of Computer-Assisted Tools in translating and editing is described correctly

objectives.text: (b) Use Computer-Assisted Translation Tools to translate and edit short simple texts
objectives.teaching_methods: Exploration, Modelling/demonstration, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Computer-Assisted Translation Tools are used appropriately to translate and edit short simple texts

sub_topics.title: Appreciate the aesthetics and value of literature
competences: (a) Assess the language used in a selected novella
(b) Compare own values and perspectives with those implied in a selected novella
(c) Dramatise episodes from a selected novella

objectives.text: (a) Assess the language used in a selected novella
objectives.resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The language used in the selected novella is assessed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Compare own values and perspectives with those implied in a selected novella
objectives.assessment_criteria: Own values and perspectives are compared appropriately with those implied in the selected novella

objectives.text: (c) Dramatise episodes from a selected novella
objectives.assessment_criteria: Episodes from the selected novella are dramatised properly

sub_topics.title: Evaluate the context in which literary texts are written, read and understood
competences: (a) Examine the socio-political and cultural issues portrayed in a selected novella
(b) Relate the context of the story in a selected novella to real life experiences

objectives.text: (a) Examine the socio-political and cultural issues portrayed in a selected novella
objectives.resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The socio-political and cultural issues portrayed in the selected novella are examined properly

objectives.text: (b) Relate the context of the story in a selected novella to real life experiences
objectives.assessment_criteria: The context of the story in the selected novella is related appropriately to real-life experiences

sub_topics.title: Analyse genres of literature and appreciate their conventions
competences: (a) Analyse techniques of critiquing literary texts based on their conventions
(b) Critique a selected novella based on form and content

objectives.text: (a) Analyse techniques of critiquing literary texts based on their conventions
objectives.resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: Techniques for critiquing literary texts based on their conventions are analysed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Critique a selected novella based on form and content
objectives.assessment_criteria: The selected novella is critiqued appropriately based on form and content

sub_topics.title: Create simple literary works
competences: (a) Apply literary skills to compose short stories on various topics
(b) Publish the short stories on various platforms (e.g., note boards and online platforms)

objectives.text: (a) Apply literary skills to compose short stories on various topics
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Collaborative and independent practice, Follow-up
objectives.assessment_criteria: Literary skills are applied appropriately to compose short stories on various topics

objectives.text: (b) Publish the short stories on various platforms (e.g., note boards and online platforms)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Short stories are published appropriately on various platforms
